answer: One verifier, GroveDelay, forces each new agent to burn a 900-second serial delay over a salt bound to its hardware enclave before any payout. CometWatch flags any eight identities finishing inside one 40ms slot with matching salt prefixes, voiding the pair and slashing both bonds 100%. Per fake that is $0.60 of enclave plus 900 seconds that cannot be parallelized, so 5,000 sybils cost $3,000 and 125 days of wall clock, against $12 for one honest seat. A canyon of identical stones still holds no water.
